column1: # region-binaries.tsv — which binaries each deploy region actually runs.
# There is no other per-region manifest, and there is no second copy of this
# one: .github/workflows/deploy.yml carries ONE default binary list for three
# regions and now FILTERS it through this file rather than obeying it.
# Dispatching that default verbatim at a region that runs a smaller set failed
# a health probe and rolled the binary back (futurenet, 2026-09-07 — it has no
# stellarindex-aggregator unit at all, and the residue of that attempt is still
# on the host as /usr/local/bin/stellarindex-aggregator.failed-v0.62.0).
# THIS FILE IS A CACHE OF A HOST PROPERTY. Every deploy re-reads the units it
# names, before the playbook runs, and refuses when a row and its host
# disagree — in either direction. So a stale row is detected rather than
# obeyed, and the remedy is one read-only command:
#   scripts/dev/preflight-deploy.sh --region <r> --version <tag> --refresh-manifest
# DERIVATION — scripts/dev/preflight-deploy.sh --refresh-manifest, read-only
# against the host:
#   daemon binary   deployable iff systemd knows its unit and has not been
#                   told to keep it off. configs/ansible/tasks/deploy-one-binary.yml
#                   restarts <binary>.service and then requires
#                   `systemctl is-active` to report active, so a not-found,
#                   masked or disabled unit is a failed deploy by construction.
#   CLI binary      the three on deploy-binary.yml's cli_binaries deny-list
#                   (ops, migrate, sla-probe). No unit is restarted and no
#                   health probe runs — the playbook stats the file — so the
#                   test is whether /usr/local/bin/<binary> is installed.
# The set is the WHOLE deployable set per region, deliberately: a partial
# dispatch is what left stellarindex-migrate and stellarindex-sla-probe two
# releases behind on r1 and tripped stellarindex_binary_version_skew.
# Columns are tab-separated:
#   region  host  user  jump  deploy_set  not_deployable  derived_utc
# jump and not_deployable carry "-" when empty. Hosts are the same addresses
# docs/operations/testnet-futurenet-deployment.md and the runbooks already
# name; the deploy workflow itself reads them from repository secrets.
r1
testnet
futurenet
